desc.testo: Aozora Bank, Ltd.  is a Japanese commercial bank that offers service in 19 branches in Japan and in 2 overseas representative offices. Originally based on the Japanese operations of the Bank of Chōsen, it was known from 1957 to 1977 as Nippon Fudosan Bank and from 1977 to 2001 as Nippon Credit Bank (NCB).
desc.trad: Aozora Bank, Ltd. è una banca commerciale giapponese che offre servizi in 19 filiali in Giappone e in 2 uffici di rappresentanza all'estero. Originariamente basata sulle operazioni giapponesi della Bank of Chōsen, era conosciuta dal 1957 al 1977 come Nippon Fudosan Bank e dal 1977 al 2001 come Nippon Credit Bank (NCB).
